1	# InkOS Onboarding — Full Rebuild Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Onboarding currently ships working UI but has **critical data-loss bugs**, **brand violations**, and a **forced-feeling 5-step gauntlet** that drops users at the first DMV-style form. Screenshot shows purple step-1 circle (brand locks palette to Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only).
6	
7	**Pain the user named:**
8	- Flow feels boring, forced, not branded
9	- Bugs exist — Yash wants zero
10	- Database integration incomplete
11	- Needs top-tier SaaS pattern polish
12	- Must carry the InkOS editorial voice
13	
14	**Outcome:** 4-step, autosave-backed, editorial-toned onboarding. Every write hits the database through typed server actions. Every color is brand-safe. Every field the user types persists. Mobile, keyboard, a11y, tests — all complete. User ends holding a live booking URL, a QR code, and a copy-paste Instagram bio link — the true first win.
15	
16	---
17	
18	## What's Broken Today (audit results)
19	
20	### Critical data-loss bugs
21	
22	| # | File | Bug |
23	|---|------|-----|
24	| 1 | [StepFirstService.tsx:72](components/onboarding/StepFirstService.tsx#L72) | Services **never inserted** — localStorage only. The form is decorative. |
25	| 2 | [StepFirstArtist.tsx:102-107](components/onboarding/StepFirstArtist.tsx#L102-L107) | Specialties **never inserted** — localStorage only. No `artists` row created. |
26	| 3 | [StepFirstLocation.tsx:60-68](components/onboarding/StepFirstLocation.tsx#L60-L68) | `phone` collected but omitted from insert. Column exists on `locations`. |
27	| 4 | [StepFirstArtist.tsx:84-99](components/onboarding/StepFirstArtist.tsx#L84-L99) | Step 3 updates `profiles.full_name` + upserts `studio_members` but **never creates the `artists` row**, so the owner isn't bookable. |
28	| 5 | All steps | All writes are client-side direct Supabase calls. No server-side validation, no audit log entry, no RPC-wrapped atomicity. |
29	| 6 | [StepStudioProfile.tsx:22-35](components/onboarding/StepStudioProfile.tsx#L22-L35) | Only 12 hardcoded timezones. UK/EU/India/Dubai/Brazil studios stuck. No auto-detect. |
30	| 7 | Service schema mismatch | Form collects `depositPct` (percent). DB stores `deposit_cents` (absolute integer). Drift guaranteed once persisted. |
31	
32	### Brand violations
33	
34	| # | File | Violation |
35	|---|------|-----------|
36	| 8 | [app/globals.css:1657-1667](app/globals.css#L1657-L1667) | `.onboarding-step-active` = `oklch(62% 0.24 292)` = **purple**. Brand palette locked to Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. |
37	| 9 | [app/globals.css:1669](app/globals.css#L1669) | `.onboarding-step-done` = `oklch(58% 0.18 145)` = green. Not a brand color. |
38	| 10 | [(auth)/layout.tsx:68](app/(auth)/layout.tsx#L68) | Inline raw hex `style={{ color: '#B23A2B' }}`. Must use `var(--color-rust)` / `text-rust`. |
39	| 11 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx:69](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L69) | `bg-success/60` on step connector. `success` is not a locked brand token. |
40	| 12 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx:110](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L110) | Decorative 3px primary bar at top of card — unneeded and breaks the "solid surface" rule. |
41	
42	### Code quality
43	
44	| # | File | Issue |
45	|---|------|-------|
46	| 13 | [StepBookingPageLive.tsx:41](components/onboarding/StepBookingPageLive.tsx#L41) | `@ts-expect-error` for posthog — must type properly via `window.posthog` ambient decl. |
47	| 14 | [StepBookingPageLive.tsx:103-108](components/onboarding/StepBookingPageLive.tsx#L103-L108) | Non-standard `render=<a/>` on Button. Use `asChild` pattern. |
48	| 15 | [StepFirstLocation.tsx:143,174](components/onboarding/StepFirstLocation.tsx#L143), [StepFirstService.tsx:105](components/onboarding/StepFirstService.tsx#L105) | `grid grid-cols-2` with no `sm:` breakpoint — cramped on 375px. |
49	| 16 | No tests | `tests/` has no onboarding coverage. Zero Playwright or unit tests. |
50	| 17 | All steps | `localStorage`-only draft state — loses data across devices/browsers. No server-side resume. |
51	| 18 | All steps | No autofocus on first field. No explicit Enter-to-advance confirmation. |
52	| 19 | [OnboardingWizard.tsx](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx) | No motion between steps — feels abrupt, not premium. |
53	| 20 | [(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx:29-37](app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx#L29-L37) | Resume logic only checks locations count. Doesn't detect WHICH step is next. User re-does completed work if they refresh mid-flow. |
54	
55	---
56	
57	## The New Flow — 4 Steps, Not 5
58	
59	Compressing from 5 to 4 by folding "First Artist" into Step 1 (the owner is already a `studio_member` at signup — we just need `full_name`, optional specialties, and one `artists` row). This kills the step with the highest drop-off risk ("why am I entering my name when I just signed up?").
60	
61	| Step | Title (serif) | Required fields | Deferred / skippable |
62	|------|---------------|-----------------|----------------------|
63	| **1. Studio** | *"Your studio."* | Studio name, timezone (auto-detected) | Logo, your specialties (chip picker) |
64	| **2. Location** | *"One location to start."* | Location name, city, country | Street, state, zip, phone |
65	| **3. First service** | *"Your first service."* | Pick a template OR fill custom | Description |
66	| **4. Go live** | *"Live."* | (display only — no input) | — |
67	
68	**What moved out of onboarding (to post-onboarding checklist on the dashboard):**
69	- Logo upload (deferred fully — dismissible "Brand your studio" card on `/dashboard`, reuses existing dropzone component)
70	- Street address / state / zip / phone (prompted on first booking that needs them)
71	- Team invites (separate settings page)
72	- Google Calendar connect (settings integration)
73	- Payment method (prompted when they try to charge a deposit)
74	
75	**Why 4 not 3:** the location step is load-bearing for the booking URL (city shows up in booking page). Cutting it makes the go-live screen generic. Four is the minimum that produces a *real* booking page.
76	
77	**Why not 5:** the artist step was drive-by busywork (name already known from auth email, specialties are optional everywhere else in the app). Merging with Step 1 saves ~20 seconds and a drop-off point.
78	
79	---
80	
81	## Server Actions — All Writes Go Through Here
82	
83	New file: `app/actions/onboarding.ts` — single module, five exports.
84	
85	```ts
86	// Signatures only — full Zod + implementation in the file
87	'use server'
88	
89	export async function saveStudioStep(input: StudioStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ slug: string }>>
90	export async function saveLocationStep(input: LocationStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ locationId: string }>>
91	export async function saveServiceStep(input: ServiceStepInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ serviceId: string }>>
92	export async function completeOnboarding(studioId: string): Promise<ActionResult<{ bookingUrl: string }>>
93	export async function getOnboardingState(): Promise<OnboardingStateSnapshot>
94	```
95	
96	**What each action does (uniform pattern):**
97	
98	1. `await createClient()` in `lib/supabase/server.ts` → session-scoped client
99	2. Verify `user` + membership in target `studioId` (use existing `studio_members` check pattern)
100	3. Parse input through `lib/onboarding/schemas.ts` Zod schemas (shared with client-side `react-hook-form` resolver)
101	4. Write to DB:
102	   - **Step 1 (studio + owner-as-artist):** UPDATE `studios`, INSERT `artists` row for owner if none exists, UPDATE `profiles.full_name`
103	   - **Step 2 (location):** INSERT `locations` (all provided columns including `phone`, `country` required, default `is_primary=true`)
104	   - **Step 3 (service):** INSERT `services` with `deposit_cents = Math.round((depositPct / 100) * basePriceCents)`, `deposit_required = depositPct > 0`
105	5. Emit audit log via existing [lib/audit.ts](lib/audit.ts) → `logAuditAction('onboarding.studio_saved', ...)` etc.
106	6. Return `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: string }`
107	
108	**No service-role bypass.** All writes go through the user's session-scoped Supabase client. RLS policies on `studios`/`locations`/`services`/`artists` already permit inserts by owners (verified via Dato's RLS patterns — confirm during build, add migration only if a policy is missing).
109	
110	**Why Server Actions not API routes:** Next 16 Server Actions give us form-native progressive enhancement + automatic CSRF + typed return without an extra route file. Stack A standard per [~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md](../../memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md).
111	
112	---
113	
114	## Server-Side Resume (no more lost drafts)
115	
116	Replace the localStorage step tracker with a server-truth check on page load.
117	
118	`app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx` becomes a hydration-ready server component that reads:
119	
120	```sql
121	-- Pseudocode of the single query the page runs
122	select
123	  s.id, s.name, s.slug, s.timezone, s.logo_url,
124	  (select count(*) from locations where studio_id = s.id) as location_count,
125	  (select count(*) from services  where studio_id = s.id) as service_count,
126	  (select count(*) from artists   where studio_id = s.id and user_id = $userId) as artist_count
127	from studios s
128	join studio_members m on m.studio_id = s.id
129	where m.user_id = $userId
130	order by m.joined_at asc
131	limit 1;
132	```
133	
134	From that snapshot, compute `resumeAt`:
135	
136	- If studio has default name OR no timezone set → step 1
137	- Else if `location_count = 0` → step 2
138	- Else if `service_count = 0` → step 3
139	- Else → step 4 (go live) — BUT if all three are done AND the user hit `/onboarding` anyway, redirect to `/dashboard`
140	
141	The wizard gets `{ studioId, userId, studio, resumeAt }` and hydrates to the right step. localStorage is kept only as a UX softening — if server says step 2 but user was on step 3 locally, trust the server.
142	
143	---
144	
145	## Redesigned Step Indicator (brand-safe)
146	
147	Kill the purple CSS classes entirely. New indicator in `components/onboarding/StepIndicator.tsx`:
148	
149	- **Active step:** Rust-filled circle (`bg-rust`), Bone number inside, soft Rust ring via `shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]`
150	- **Completed step:** Onyx-filled circle (`bg-onyx`), Bone check icon inside
151	- **Future step:** Bone background (`bg-bone`), Stone border + Stone number
152	- **Connector line:** `bg-onyx` for completed segments, `bg-border` (Stone-tinted) for upcoming
153	- **Label under each:** Inter 10px/600 uppercase tracked 0.08em, Stone for inactive, Onyx for active
154	- **Mobile:** labels hide (<sm), circles shrink to 6px dots inline with "Step X of 4" text on the right
155	- Respect **one-Rust-per-viewport** rule — active step is the only Rust in the right panel
156	
157	Remove the 3px top primary bar from [OnboardingWizard.tsx:110](components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx#L110). The card is the frame.
158	
159	Remove the [globals.css:1656-1667](app/globals.css#L1656-L1667) block. Done inline with Tailwind 4 utilities on the indicator element.
160	
161	---
162	
163	## Motion (restraint, not showbiz)
164	
165	Between steps: 180ms cross-fade + 4px upward slide on the new content. CSS-only via Tailwind 4 `animate-in` utility class + `data-[step]` attribute transitions. No Framer Motion — weight budget.
166	
167	- Step card container gets `key={currentStep}` so React unmounts/remounts, which triggers `animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-1 duration-200 ease-out` on the inner step.
168	- The StepIndicator transitions its circle colors/ring via CSS `transition-all duration-200 ease-out`.
169	- No spinners on button click under 400ms. If the server action takes longer, swap label to "Saving…" with no spinner icon.
170	- Brand rule 4.5 honored: the only other motion on the page is the Onyx panel's hero (static anyway).
171	
172	---
173	
174	## Editorial Copy Rewrite (Quill voice)
175	
176	Per CLAUDE.md §6 — *editorial, quiet, confident. No exclamation marks. No hype.*
177	
178	| Step | Title (Instrument Serif 32-36px) | Subtitle (Inter 14px, Stone) |
179	|------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|
180	| 1 | *Your studio.* | "Two minutes to a live booking page." |
181	| 2 | *One location, to start.* | "You can add more later. The essentials are enough." |
182	| 3 | *Your first service.* | "Pick a template or write your own. You'll edit it later." |
183	| 4 | *Live.* | "Your booking page is public. Share the link." |
184	
185	**Field labels stay sentence case, Inter 11px/700 uppercase tracked 0.08em** per brand type scale.
186	
187	**Button copy:**
188	- Primary: `Continue` (no arrow glyph — too SaaS-y)
189	- Back: `Back`
190	- Skip: `Skip for now` (kept as ghost button, Stone text)
191	- Final: `Open the studio` (not "Go to dashboard" — editorial anchor)
192	
193	**Errors:** factual, no "Oops!".
194	- "Studio name must be at least 2 characters."
195	- "We couldn't save this step. Try again, or refresh the page."
196	
197	**Empty-state microcopy on the timezone combobox:** *"Couldn't find that timezone. Try 'New York' or 'London'."*
198	
199	---

201	## Step 1 Detail — Studio
202	
203	**Fields:**
204	- **Studio name** (required, 2-60) — autofocus on page load
205	- **Booking URL preview** (computed, non-editable live preview) — `book.inkos.app/dark-matter-tattoo` updating as user types
206	- **Timezone** (required) — searchable combobox, defaults to `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`
207	- **Your name** (required, 2-80) — prefilled from auth session's `email` localpart if `profiles.full_name` is null
208	- **Your specialties** (optional, chip picker — 10 presets from existing list)
209

211	
212	**New components:**
213	- `components/onboarding/TimezoneCombobox.tsx` — wraps shadcn `<Command>` over `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')` output, grouped by continent. Auto-detects on mount. ~400 lines including list.
214	- `components/onboarding/SlugPreview.tsx` — renders `book.inkos.app/<slug>` with debounced slug generation from the name field via the existing `slugify()` in [lib/utils.ts](lib/utils.ts).

217	**Why slug preview matters:** the booking URL is the final deliverable. Showing it live during Step 1 lets the user shape it (rename to fix auto-slug collisions). Kills the "I didn't know that would be my URL" regret.
218

220	- UPDATE `studios` set `name`, `timezone`, `logo_url`, (if slug changed) `slug`
221	- UPSERT `artists` row for `(studio_id, user_id)` with `full_name`, `specialties`

# InkOS Onboarding v2 — Design Spec

**Produced by:** Vega (Design Lead)
**Date:** 2026-04-24
**For:** Koda (implementation), Sage (review gate)
**Plan source:** `~/.claude/plans/for-onboaring-lets-optimize-virtual-karp.md`
**Brand authority:** `CLAUDE.md §4` + `app/globals.css @theme inline`

---

## Brand-Safety Reminder

The entire InkOS palette is exactly four colors. Every pixel in every component below must use only these four, via CSS tokens — never raw hex, never inline styles with color values.

| Token (Tailwind utility) | CSS variable | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bg-bone` / `text-bone` | `var(--color-bone)` | `#F7F7F5` | Page canvas, card surfaces, text-on-dark |
| `bg-onyx` / `text-onyx` | `var(--color-onyx)` | `#0F0F0F` | Primary text, primary CTAs, completed states |
| `bg-stone` / `text-stone` | `var(--color-stone)` | `#787774` | Secondary text, labels, borders, inactive states |
| `bg-rust` / `text-rust` | `var(--color-rust)` | `#B23A2B` | Active step (only), one accent per viewport |

`bg-border` resolves to the Stone-tinted border token `oklch(91% 0.005 85)` — use it for connector lines and inactive borders.

**Rust budget per viewport: once or twice maximum.** On the onboarding card the active `StepIndicator` circle is the one Rust element. The "Most studios pick this" dot in `ServiceTemplatePicker` is the second. Nothing else uses Rust anywhere in the onboarding flow.

---

## DO NOT USE List

Any of the following in onboarding components is a hard Sage block:

- `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, `shadow-2xl` — Tailwind defaults; use named tokens
- `bg-white` — use `bg-bone`
- `bg-black` — use `bg-onyx`
- `bg-card` — permitted on inner card surfaces only where it resolves to white; on the wizard outer card use `bg-bone`
- `bg-purple-*`, `bg-blue-*`, `bg-green-*`, `bg-teal-*`, `bg-success`, `bg-warning`, `bg-accent` as a fill
- Raw hex literals in any `.tsx` file
- `style={{ color: '...' }}` with any color value
- `oklch(...)` directly in component files — only `globals.css` holds raw color values
- `bg-primary` on non-CTA elements (primary = Onyx, which is correct for buttons but wrong for backgrounds)
- `text-destructive` used as a general red accent — destructive is reserved for error/delete states only
- `animate-spin`, `animate-bounce`, `animate-pulse` — none of these belong in the onboarding flow
- Gradients of any kind

---

## 1. StepIndicator

**File:** `components/onboarding/StepIndicator.tsx`

**Purpose:** Horizontal 4-circle + 3-connector progress bar that communicates the user's position in the 4-step wizard. Brand-safe replacement for the current purple/green CSS classes in `app/globals.css` (lines 1656–1667, which must be deleted).

### Layout

```
Desktop (sm and above):

  [●] ——————— [●] ——————— [●] ——————— [●]
  Your         One          Your         Live.
  studio.      location.    first
               to start.    service.

Mobile (below sm — 375px viewport):

  [·] — [·] — [·] — [·]     Step 2 of 4
```

Desktop: full horizontal row with circles, connectors, and labels.
Mobile: circles shrink to 6×6 dots (no labels, no connectors as lines — dots separated by `mx-1` gaps), followed by Inter 12px/600 Stone text "Step N of 4" positioned to the right via `flex items-center justify-between`.

**Decision — dots-only mobile (not shrunk circles):** On a 375px viewport a row of four 6×6 dots plus the "Step N of 4" label fits in one `flex items-center` row at 44px total height without overflow. Shrunk 24px circles (down from 32px desktop) would still crowd labels. Dots are cleaner and faster to scan. The "Step N of 4" text preserves orientation without requiring labels.

### Circle dimensions

| Breakpoint | Circle size | Tailwind classes |
|---|---|---|
| `<sm` (mobile, dots-only mode) | 6×6px | `size-1.5` |
| `sm` and above | 32×32px | `size-8` |

### State classes

#### Active (current step)

```
Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-rust flex items-center justify-center
            transition-all duration-200 ease-out
            shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]

Number:     text-bone font-sans text-[13px] font-semibold leading-none tabular-nums
```

Full class string for the circle div:
`size-8 rounded-full bg-rust flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--color-rust)_12%,transparent)]`

#### Completed (step index < current step)

```
Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-onyx flex items-center justify-center
            transition-all duration-200 ease-out

Icon:       Lucide CheckIcon, size-4, text-bone stroke-width={2.5}
```

Full class string for the circle div:
`size-8 rounded-full bg-onyx flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out`

The check icon: `<CheckIcon className="size-4 text-bone" strokeWidth={2.5} />`

#### Future (step index > current step)

```
Container:  size-8 rounded-full bg-bone border border-border flex items-center justify-center
            transition-all duration-200 ease-out

Number:     text-stone font-sans text-[13px] font-semibold leading-none tabular-nums
```

Full class string for the circle div:
`size-8 rounded-full bg-bone border border-border flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 ease-out`

#### Mobile dot states

| State | Classes |
|---|---|
| Active | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-rust transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |
| Completed | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-onyx transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |
| Future | `size-1.5 rounded-full bg-bone border border-stone transition-all duration-200 ease-out` |

### Connector line

The connector is a `flex-1` `h-px` div between each pair of circles.

- **Completed segment** (connects two completed circles, or completed to active): `flex-1 h-px bg-onyx transition-colors duration-200 ease-out`
- **Upcoming segment** (connects active to future, or future to future): `flex-1 h-px bg-border transition-colors duration-200 ease-out`

Rule: a segment is "completed" if its left-hand circle is in the completed state. The segment between completed step N and the active step N+1 is completed.

On mobile dot mode, connectors are replaced by `mx-1` spacing on each dot — no visible line element.

### Labels

Rendered below each circle as a sibling `<span>`, not inside the circle container.

```
Label (active):   font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em]
                  text-onyx mt-2 text-center whitespace-nowrap

Label (completed/future):  font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em]
                            text-stone mt-2 text-center whitespace-nowrap
```

Label text values (match the step titles):
1. "YOUR STUDIO."
2. "LOCATION."
3. "FIRST SERVICE."
4. "LIVE."

Labels are hidden on mobile: wrap in `hidden sm:block`.

### Step counter text (mobile only)

```
"Step {currentStep} of 4"
font-sans text-[12px] font-semibold text-stone
```

Hidden at sm and above: `block sm:hidden`.

### Component structure (prose, not JSX)

The component receives `currentStep` (1-indexed, 1–4) and `steps` (array of 4 label strings). It renders:

- Outer wrapper: `flex items-center w-full` (desktop) — on mobile, the wrapper switches to `flex items-center justify-between` to place dots left, counter right.
- For each step (1–4): a `flex flex-col items-center` column containing the circle and its label, connected to the next step by the connector div using `flex-1`. The column and connector live inside a `flex items-center w-full` row.

### Transition timing

All state transitions (idle → active, active → completed) animate via `transition-all duration-200 ease-out` on each circle's className. The Rust ring on the active state appears/disappears with the same 200ms ease-out. No JS animation — pure Tailwind transition utilities driven by class swaps on prop change.

### Data contract

```
Props:
  currentStep: number   // 1-indexed (1 = Step 1 active)
  steps: string[]       // Array of 4 label strings (uppercase, period-terminated)

Emits: nothing (display-only component)
```

### Accessibility

- Wrap in `<nav aria-label="Onboarding progress">`.
- Each step item: `role="listitem"`.
- Active circle: `aria-current="step"`.
- Completed circle: `aria-label="{stepLabel} — completed"`.
- Future circle: `aria-label="{stepLabel} — upcoming"`.
- The progress row: `role="list"`.
- Mobile counter span: `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce step changes.
- No keyboard interaction — the indicator is display-only; navigation is controlled by the wizard's Continue/Back buttons.

### Focus ring

No focus ring on this component — it is non-interactive.

---

## 2. OnboardingWizard

**File:** `components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx`

**Purpose:** Card container that wraps the step indicator, step title, and step body. Manages the `currentStep` state and triggers the cross-fade animation between steps.

### Layout

```
[  InkOS wordmark + "Studio OS" subtitle                        ]
                       ↕ 32px gap
[  StepIndicator (full width)                                   ]
                       ↕ 40px gap
[  Step title (Instrument Serif, 32px)                          ]
[  Step subtitle (Inter 14px, Stone)                            ]
                       ↕ 24px gap
[  Step body (variable — the active step component)             ]
                       ↕ 32px gap
[  Back (ghost, left) ←——————————————→ Continue (primary, right)]
```

### Card frame

```
Outer wrapper (centers the card on page):
  min-h-screen bg-bone flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-8

Card:
  w-full max-w-lg bg-bone rounded-2xl shadow-soft-md
  border border-border
  p-8 sm:p-10
```

`max-w-lg` = 512px. This fits the service template grid (3 columns × narrow cards) and the booking link card without horizontal scroll at 375px (the card goes full-width at small viewport, padded at `px-4`).

`rounded-2xl` = `--radius-2xl` = 24px. Matches the large-modal token.

`shadow-soft-md` = `0 4px 16px -4px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.10), 0 2px 8px -2px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.07)`. This token is already defined in `globals.css`.

**No 3px primary/Rust top bar.** Remove the element at `OnboardingWizard.tsx:110` entirely. The card border is the frame.

### Wordmark

Position: above the card, centered, 32px margin-bottom.

```
Horizontal lockup: Onyx tile (32px) + "InkOS" wordmark (Inter 18px/700 text-onyx) +
"Studio OS" subtitle below the wordmark (Inter 10px/600 uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-stone)
```

Class string for the wordmark row: `flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-8`

### Spacing between wordmark → indicator → title → body

| Gap | Value | Tailwind |
|---|---|---|
| Wordmark → StepIndicator | 32px | `mb-8` on wordmark wrapper |
| StepIndicator → step title | 40px | `mt-10` on title wrapper |
| Step title → step subtitle | 4px | `mt-1` |
| Step subtitle → step body | 24px | `mt-6` |
| Step body → button row | 32px | `mt-8` |

### Step body cross-fade animation

The step body container renders the active step component with `key={currentStep}`. React will unmount the old step and mount the new one on step change.

On the inner step wrapper div, apply these Tailwind classes:
```
animate-in fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-1 duration-200 ease-out
```

These classes come from `tw-animate-css` which is already imported in `globals.css`. No additional imports needed.

The `StepIndicator` does NOT get `key` — it persists and transitions its circle styles in-place via CSS transitions.

### Button row

```
Layout:       flex items-center justify-between gap-3
              flex-row (always — Back and Continue never stack)

Back button:  variant="ghost"  size="default"
              text-stone text-[14px] font-medium

## 5. SlugPreview

**File:** `components/onboarding/SlugPreview.tsx`

**Purpose:** Live booking URL preview rendered below the studio name input on Step 1. Updates as the user types, debounced 200ms, showing the auto-slugified version of the studio name.

### Layout

```
book.inkos.app / dark-matter-tattoo
[←   Stone mono prefix  →][← Onyx mono slug →]

Full width, no border, no input affordance — this is display-only.
Positioned directly below the studio name Input, with mt-2 gap.
```

### Typography

```
Container: flex items-center gap-0 mt-2

Prefix "book.inkos.app/":
  font-mono text-[12px] font-normal text-stone leading-none
  class: font-mono text-xs text-stone leading-none

Slug portion:
  font-mono text-[12px] font-medium text-onyx leading-none
  class: font-mono text-xs font-medium text-onyx leading-none
  Renders the slugified value, or the empty state
```

The prefix and slug are two `<span>` elements inside the container `<p>`. No wrapping — both are `whitespace-nowrap`. If the combined width exceeds the container at 375px, truncate the slug with `overflow-hidden text-ellipsis max-w-[calc(100%-9rem)]` on the slug span (reserving ~144px for the prefix).

### Empty state

When the studio name input is empty, the slug span renders:

```
Instrument Serif italic, 12px, Stone
Text: "your-studio-name"
class: font-serif italic text-xs text-stone leading-none
```

This is the one permitted Instrument Serif usage at body-text scale — the brand rule says "serif for moments", and the empty state name is a moment per brand rule 4.7 ("Empty-state serif italic exception"). The italic placeholder communicates "fill this in" without a generic input placeholder.

### Debounce

200ms debounce on the incoming `studioName` prop value. The slug computation runs `slugify(debouncedName)` from `lib/utils.ts`. During the 200ms debounce window, the displayed slug is the last committed value (no flicker, no "..." loading state — debounce is fast enough to not need one).

### Data contract

```
Props:
  studioName: string    // raw value from the studio name input — updated on every keystroke

Internal:
  debouncedName: string — 200ms debounced version of studioName

Emits: nothing (display-only)
```

### Accessibility

- The container `<p>`: `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce the slug as it settles (debounce means it fires after the user pauses, not on every keystroke).
- `aria-label="Your booking URL: book.inkos.app/{slug}"` on the container — the full URL for screen reader context.
- No focus ring — non-interactive.

### Motion

None. The text updates are instant (no fade, no slide). Stillness is the brand; a typing preview does not need animation.

**File:** `components/onboarding/TimezoneCombobox.tsx`

**Purpose:** Searchable timezone picker for Step 1, replacing the hardcoded 12-timezone `<select>`. Built on shadcn `<Command>` inside a `<Popover>`. Auto-detects the user's current timezone on mount. Groups timezones by continent.

### Layout

```
[Trigger — styled as Input, same height/border]
     ↓ (open)
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  [Search input — "Search timezones…"]        │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────  │
│  AFRICA                                      │
│    Africa/Abidjan                            │
│    Africa/Accra                              │
│    …                                         │
│  AMERICA                                     │
│    America/Adak                              │
│    America/Anchorage                         │
│    …                                         │
│  (+ 7 continent groups total)                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Trigger

The trigger must be visually indistinguishable from the other `<Input>` elements on the form (same height, same border, same padding, same font). It is NOT a button that looks like a button.

```
Trigger classes (applied to the PopoverTrigger > button or div):
  flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-bone px-3 py-1
  font-sans text-[14px] font-normal text-onyx
  placeholder:text-stone
  focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-0
  disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
  cursor-pointer
```

When a timezone is selected, display the IANA timezone string (e.g., "America/New_York"). When no selection, display placeholder "Select timezone…" in Stone.

A Lucide `ChevronDownIcon` (size-4 text-stone) sits at the right edge via `flex items-center justify-between`.

### Popover

```
PopoverContent classes:
  w-[--radix-popover-trigger-width] p-0
  bg-bone border border-stone rounded-xl shadow-lift
  max-h-64 overflow-hidden
```

`w-[--radix-popover-trigger-width]` ensures the popover matches the trigger width exactly (this is the Radix CSS variable pattern).

`max-h-64` = 256px. The `CommandList` inside handles its own scroll.

### CommandList structure

```
<Command>
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search timezones…" className="font-sans text-[14px] text-onyx placeholder:text-stone" />
  <CommandList className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
    <CommandEmpty className="font-sans text-[14px] text-stone py-4 text-center italic font-serif">
      Couldn't find that timezone. Try "New York" or "London".
    </CommandEmpty>
    {CONTINENT_GROUPS.map(group => (
      <CommandGroup heading={group.continent} key={group.continent}>
        {group.timezones.map(tz => (
          <CommandItem key={tz} value={tz}>
            {tz}   {/* display as raw IANA string — no pretty-printing in v1 */}
          </CommandItem>
        ))}
      </CommandGroup>
    ))}
  </CommandList>
</Command>
```

`CommandGroup` heading:
```
font-sans text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-stone px-3 py-1.5
```
This matches the `label` token from the brand type scale.

`CommandItem` (individual timezone row):
```
Idle:     font-sans text-[14px] font-normal text-onyx cursor-pointer px-3 py-2
          hover:bg-accent rounded-lg mx-1
Selected: same + Lucide CheckIcon (size-4 text-onyx) at far right
```

`bg-accent` = `rgba(178, 58, 43, 0.08)` — the Rust 8% tint. This is the defined accent token and is correct for hover states (same as sidebar active row).

### CommandEmpty

The empty state message uses Instrument Serif italic on one line only — this is a "moment" as permitted by the brand (an empty-state editorial response). Classes: `font-serif italic text-[14px] text-stone py-6 text-center`.

Text: *"Couldn't find that timezone. Try 'New York' or 'London'."*

### Continent grouping

Derived from `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')`. The prefix before the first `/` is the continent key. Groups and their order:

```
Africa · America · Antarctica · Arctic · Asia · Atlantic · Australia · Europe · Indian · Pacific
```

Omit `Etc/` and `UTC` variants — they produce noisy machine-legible strings. Only include entries that contain a `/` (which excludes bare `UTC`).

The `lib/onboarding/timezone.ts` module (Koda's file) exports this grouped list. `TimezoneCombobox` imports the grouped array — it does not call `Intl.supportedValuesOf` directly (that call belongs in the module).

### Auto-detect on mount

```typescript
// Inside the component (prose — not JSX):
// On mount: call Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone
// If the detected tz is in the grouped list, call onSelect(detectedTz) immediately
// If not found (rare edge case on unusual browsers), leave empty
```

This fires once in a `useEffect([], [])` — no re-detection on re-renders.

### Keyboard behavior

All keyboard behavior is inherited from shadcn `<Command>`:
- `↑` / `↓`: moves through items
- `Enter`: selects the highlighted item and closes the popover
- `Esc`: closes the popover without changing selection, returns focus to the trigger
- Type characters: filters the list (Command's built-in fuzzy match)

No custom keyboard override needed.

### Data contract

```
Props:
  value: string                   // selected IANA timezone string, or ""
  onValueChange: (tz: string) => void

Emits: onValueChange(tz) when user selects a timezone
```

### Accessibility

- The trigger button: `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded={open}`, `aria-label="Select timezone"`.
- The popover content: `role="listbox"`.
- Selected item: `aria-selected="true"`.
- CommandInput: `role="searchbox"`, `aria-label="Search timezones"`, `aria-controls` pointing to the listbox.
- The `CommandEmpty` text is rendered in the DOM when the list is empty — no additional aria needed.
- Focus ring: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring` on the trigger.

### Shadow token

Popover uses `shadow-lift` = `0 8px 24px -4px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.14), 0 4px 10px -2px oklch(13% 0.015 85 / 0.08)`. This is the correct token for floating elements (command palette, tooltips, dropdowns).
